candidates.rationale: Paul acknowledges that different people contribute to the work—one plants, another waters, but all are co-workers together with God.
Paul expresses deep gratitude to Priscilla and Aquila, his fellow workers who risked their lives for him and whose help all the churches appreciated.
Paul thanks the Philippians for their partnership and repeated help in his ministry, acknowledging their shared work and support.
Paul urges believers to respect and esteem highly those who labor among them and help them, giving honor where it is due.
Two are better than one because they have a good return for their labor, and one can help the other when they fall—celebrating mutual assistance.
